title: StandingPolicy
description: A signed human decision authorising a class of future actions rather than a single one (ADR 0019). Bounded to one product, created by a gated decision, cited by every action taken under it, and revocable by another recorded decision. Production promotion, baseline approval and offboarding are non-delegable and cannot be expressed here.

productId.description: Scope is always exactly one product. A policy is never global.

actions.description: Closed set. A policy that authorises nothing is a config flag pretending to be a decision, so minItems is 1.

authorisingDecisionId.description: The gated HumanDecision that created this policy.

rationale.description: Why the human authorised this, so 'why does this happen without me?' stays answerable.

revocationDecisionId.description: Withdrawing trust is as auditable as granting it.
